name: Improve FuzzyId support
summary: Implement INamespaced for World and Task. Architecture: Replace FormaList with FuzzyNamespace entirely as single unified system. (1) Extend FuzzyNamespace: add patchForma(), event bus support, mutation methods. (2) World implements INamespaced: namespace(bus) returns FuzzyNamespace of all top-level entities. (3) Task implements INamespaced: namespace(bus) returns combined FuzzyNamespace of actions + references (no more disjoint namespaces). (4) Update clients: CLI, tests to use namespace(bus). Key files: src/fuzzy-namespace.ts, src/world.ts, src/task.ts, src/forma-list.ts (to replace), src/cli/cli-task.ts (to update).

rawActions.summary: Task currently manages two disjoint FormaLists (rawActions, rawReferences) within a single work context. Migrate clients from task.actions(bus)+task.references(bus) to unified task.namespace(bus). Part of FormaList→FuzzyNamespace replacement.
